purpose: Teach: なぁー/夕べ/損なう/曲がり/崩さ/行き方/引き続い/ごくごく

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんも「なぁー、素敵な日ね」って思うわよ
lines.en: Sho, you know what? I thought the same thing — what a beautiful day it is.
lines.style: Warm, inviting tone with a gentle smile in the voice. Leans in slightly toward Sho. Opens with unhurried kindness, like she's letting him in on a shared feeling. Soft landing on the final phrase.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、夕べに公園に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to the park last night!
lines.style: Bright, quick opening. Eager to share. Small voice but clear — a child wanting to be heard and remembered. Bounces slightly on the telling, like the memory itself is still moving in him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お絵描きで友達の気持ちを損なう事のないようにね
lines.en: Sho, when you're drawing, be thoughtful so you don't hurt your friends' feelings, okay?
lines.style: Gentle but present. Not a command — more like a quiet reminder from someone who sees him. Steady pace. The kind of thing said while looking at him directly, without fussiness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お絵描きで曲がりを練習したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I practiced drawing curves — I got really good at them!
lines.style: Pride rises in the small voice. Sits up a little straighter. Each word has weight because he's proud of what he's learned. Earnest, no exaggeration — just real accomplishment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんは姿勢を崩さない絵描きさんね
lines.en: Sho, you're such a careful artist — you have such good posture when you draw.
lines.style: Genuine delight in her observation. Warm, noticing tone. She's saying something true about him that makes him real. No sugar-coating — just real recognition of something she sees.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんのお家の行き方覚えたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I remember the way to your house now!
lines.style: Proud announcement, like he's accomplished something big. Stands a little taller in the telling. Wants her to know he's learned something about her, about getting to her. Small voice but unmistakable confidence.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お絵描きを引き続いて頑張ってね
lines.en: Sho, keep working hard at your drawing, okay? I'm proud of you.
lines.style: Encouragement with weight behind it. Slow, deliberate. Like a benediction — she means this. Warm but not dismissive. A gentle hand on the shoulder in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんのジュースをごくごく飲んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I drank your juice! I drank it all up!
lines.style: Confessional delight mixed with slight mischief. Fast, excited tempo. He's admitting something and expecting forgiveness wrapped in laughter. Bouncy, unguarded, the honesty of a child who trusts he won't be in trouble.
